monthlyUpdates.text: August was an active month for Keystone Painting. We launched a full set of 6 neighborhood-specific content pages (Harmony Club, Serratoga Falls, Timnath Lakes, Timnath Ranch, Trailside, and Wildwing) — each with hyperlocal copy targeting that neighborhood specifically. We also launched a new How It Works page with a two-track layout for Standard vs. HOA neighborhoods, updated all blog geo targeting to focus on Timnath, Severance, and Windsor, and fixed the homepage reviews section to a clean 3-up carousel. Meta Ads kept the brand visible throughout the month, and Local Falcon data shows continued local map pack presence heading into fall.

July was a productive build month for Keystone Painting. We built out the blog with imagery across 8 posts, launched a new mobile-optimized sign-up landing page for ad traffic (with gallery carousel and form routing), and completed a conversion tracking audit — everything was confirmed clean. Fathom Analytics was wired in to power the Site Health section of this dashboard. The site captured 3 form submissions and 4 GBP calls in July — solid early signals with more expected as the new content continues to index.
